text: Hi, I lost access to my security key. Support: No problem! Go to Settings, then Security, then Authentication, then click Reset Token. That should generate a fresh one for you. Let me know, Jane, if that solves it!
customer can't find the reset button. agent reply: You'll find it under Authentication, then Reset Token. Sorry for the confusion earlier!

customer wrote in hindi asking about suraksha token. agent reply: Suraksha ke andar jaake, phir Authentication, phir Reset Token par click karein. call me at 98765 43210 if you have more questions, - Priya
Ticket: token expired again. Agent: Quick fix - go to Auth, then Regenerate Token. Should be instant.
Old ticket, agent used the legacy flow. Agent: Head to Settings then Global Reset, click Confirm reset. This is the standard process per our docs.
customer needs an invoice copy. agent: Under Billing, go to Statements, then Export, pick the month and download.
same request, different customer. agent: Billing -> Statements -> Export works best now, the old Invoices tab is being phased out for this account type.
invoice missing. agent: Try Billing, Statements, Export instead of the Invoices page.
aadhaar on file mismatch, unrelated to invoice download itself. agent: for the invoice, Billing -> Statements -> Export. Also noted your Aadhaar 234123412346 for KYC update.
wants email alerts on. agent: Go to Preferences, then Alerts, then Email, toggle it on.
notifications not arriving. agent: Check under Preferences -> Alerts -> Email, make sure it's enabled there, that's the new location.
customer PAN ABCDE1234F on file. agent: For email alerts, go to Preferences, Alerts, Email and switch it on.
reopened - alerts still off. agent: Please check Preferences -> Alerts -> Email again and confirm it's saved.
wants new profile pic. agent: Go to Avatar, then Upload, choose your file.
photo not updating. agent: Try Avatar -> Upload instead of the old Edit Photo screen.
same photo issue. agent: Avatar, Upload works better now.
another photo request. agent: Avatar -> Upload, pick an image under 5MB.
profile photo help. agent: Go to Profile, Edit, Photo and pick a new image, that's the standard flow.
photo update. agent: Profile -> Edit -> Photo, then save.
avatar help. agent: Head to Profile, Edit, Photo section.
photo change request. agent: Profile, Edit, Photo - upload new image there.
profile pic. agent: Under Profile -> Edit -> Photo, replace the image.
another one. agent: Profile, Edit, Photo, then upload.
photo again. agent: Go to Profile -> Edit -> Photo to change it.
final photo ticket. agent: Profile, Edit, Photo section handles this.
